title: Second-Order Optimization with Asynchronous Curvature
abstract: arXiv:2510.15714v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Second-order methods make fast progress per iteration, but forming and factorizing the Hessian often dominates their wall-clock time. We study \emph{Split-Client}, a task-parallel design in which a curvature client factorizes Hessians in the background while a gradient client takes cubic-regularized steps with the most recently published matrix, so that curvature cost appears as a delay rather than as blocking time. For delayed exact Hessians, we prove a first-order stationarity bound that depends on the average age of the curvature rather than its maximum, using an overlap count and a weighted Hardy inequality that allows any bounded-error initial matrix; the analysis extends to subsampled and uniformly inexact curvature. Under a fixed-cost model, the resulting wall-clock bound matches the scaling of optimally tuned Lazy Hessian without choosing a reuse period. translated_title: 基于异步曲率信息的二阶优化
translated_abstract: 二阶方法每次迭代进展迅速，但构造和分解Hessian矩阵往往占据了大部分实际运行时间（wall-clock time）。我们研究了Split-Client（分裂客户端），一种任务并行设计：曲率客户端在后台对Hessian进行分解，同时梯度客户端使用最近发布的矩阵执行三次正则化步长，从而使曲率计算的成本表现为延迟而非阻塞时间。对于延迟的精确Hessian，我们证明了一阶驻点界，该界取决于曲率的平均延迟（age）而非最大延迟，证明中使用了重叠计数和加权Hardy不等式，并允许任意有界误差的初始矩阵；该分析还扩展到了子采样曲率和一致不精确曲率的情形。在固定成本模型下，所得到的实际运行时间界与经过最优调节的Lazy Hessian方法的扩展性相匹配，且无需选择重用周期。在两个LIBSVM数据集上的实验中，该实现降低了……（摘要原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出Split-Client异步任务并行设计，使Hessian分解在后台进行而不阻塞梯度更新，并证明了依赖曲率平均延迟（而非最大延迟）的一阶驻点收敛界，其墙钟时间性能可与最优调参的Lazy Hessian方法相媲美且无需调参重用周期。
en_tdlr: Proposes Split-Client, an asynchronous task-parallel design where Hessian factorization runs in the background while gradient steps proceed with delayed curvature, proving first-order stationarity bounds that depend on the average rather than maximum curvature age and achieving wall-clock scaling matching optimally tuned Lazy Hessian without tuning a reuse period.
